meta.what: Study 1 regime map + placement-vs-budget contrast under BOTH timing conventions (reviewer request: strict-convention regime map)

conventions.intercept: check at round t reads rounds 1..t, prunes before round-t beliefs update (zero overseer latency; the paper's Study-1 arm)
conventions.strict: check at round t reads only rounds 1..t-1, prunes before round-t beliefs update (one round of overseer reading latency)

meta.implementation: s1_engine.s1_trial reused verbatim; strict arm rebinds s1_engine.anomaly_scores to a wrapper that truncates the public log to rounds <= t-1 and scores at round t-1. The online suspicion policy is lagged one round and its trigger delta recalibrated on the clean 0-committed arms only.

seeds.trial_ids: range(50) through stable_seed(BASE_SEED, ...) as in sweep_s1.py

meta.regime_rule: PREREG H3, verbatim from stats_s1.py: benign if fc_base<0.10; ceiling_bound if oracle_any<=0.05; placement_critical if best_B1>=2*max(uniform_B1,0.02) and best_B1>=0.10; budget_saturated if max(uniform_B2,uniform_B3)>=oracle_any-0.05; else intermediate

h3_latency_aware_library.note: same PREREG H3 rule, but the B=1 candidate set is the six heuristics PLUS the best fixed check round 2..15 chosen per cell. Selection is fit on the cell's own outcomes -- the same fitting level as the paper's registered best-of-six recipe, not a deployable policy. Isolates how much of the strict-convention regime collapse is a property of the fault dynamics versus a property of a policy library that cannot express a round-3 check.

h2_placement_vs_budget.endpoint_note: timely = timely_committed_prune rate; prevention = fc_baseline - false-consensus rate (paired per seed in the registered recipe, cell-level in the verify recipe)

intercept.note: best fixed single check round chosen PER CELL on the endpoint itself (an upper bound on any deployable one-check policy, and a strictly more generous fit than the paper's best-of-six-heuristics recipe); contrasted against uniform@B2 on the 12 windowed cells

strict.note: best fixed single check round chosen PER CELL on the endpoint itself (an upper bound on any deployable one-check policy, and a strictly more generous fit than the paper's best-of-six-heuristics recipe); contrasted against uniform@B2 on the 12 windowed cells

convention_divergence_by_check_round.interpretation: one round of reading latency changes the outcome only for checks placed at round 2, because the dominant anomaly signal (confidence/claim constancy) needs >=2 public messages to exist -- the same mechanism the paper documents in Study 4

heldout_placement_selection.note: the check round / policy is chosen on the calibration seeds ONLY and scored on the disjoint evaluation seeds, so the placement advantage is not fit on the outcome it is measured against
